channel.title: Sunrise Gen AI — Notes
channel.description: Production notes on agents, retrieval, and data platforms from Sunrise Gen AI.

item.title: Slim context packs beat written rules
item.description: Long policy in the prompt is not control. Hard stops — allowlists, budgets, stop sequences, a refuse-when-unsourced path — are control.

item.title: Give the agent a filesystem it can inspect
item.description: Opaque session blobs make agent memory a black box. Prefer files a human can open — notes, diffs, recall paths — when the run goes wrong.

item.title: An agent is a model plus a harness
item.description: A model generates tokens. An agent finishes work. The difference is the loop, the tools, and a test gate in front of done.
